_note: Manual test case blocks for the Final Technical Document. Each entry is rendered as one bordered table by docs/generate_testcases_ftd_pdf.py. 'tc' and 'ref' carry traceability back to the automated test that proves the same behaviour. 'task_id' is assigned sequentially at render time.

groups.name: Guest: Landing Page and Dynamic Content

cases.scenario: Verify that the landing page text is loaded from the database rather than fixed in the page code
prerequisites: Landing content has been saved by an admin
Database can be accessed
steps: Guest opens the site home page
Guest compares the headline and description text against the values held in the landing content table
data: The saved landing content records
cases.expected: The home page displays the text stored in the database, and no heading or description is hardcoded in the page.

cases.scenario: Verify that the landing page still renders when the content lookup fails
prerequisites: The landing content source is unavailable or returns an error
steps: Guest opens the site home page while the content lookup is failing
data: A failing landing content request
cases.expected: The home page loads with its default text and no error page is shown to the guest.

cases.scenario: Verify that an admin can change the landing page text without a code change
prerequisites: Admin is logged in
Database can be accessed
steps: Admin opens the landing content editor
Admin edits the headline and description fields
Admin clicks Save
Admin opens the public home page
data: A new headline value
A new description value
cases.expected: The new values are saved and the public home page shows the updated text straight away.

cases.scenario: Verify that landing page text containing HTML markup is rejected
prerequisites: Admin is logged in
steps: Admin opens the landing content editor
Admin enters a value that contains HTML markup
Admin clicks Save
data: A headline value containing an HTML script tag
cases.expected: The save is refused with a validation message, the value is not stored, and the public page is unchanged.

cases.scenario: Verify that a guest can search listings by keyword without logging in
prerequisites: At least one active listing matches the keyword
No user is logged in
steps: Guest types a keyword into the search box
Guest presses Enter
data: The keyword laptop
cases.expected: The results page lists the active listings that match the keyword.

cases.scenario: Verify that a search keyword cannot be used to inject SQL
prerequisites: Database can be accessed
steps: Guest types an SQL injection string into the search box
Guest presses Enter
data: The keyword ' OR '1'='1
cases.expected: The string is treated as ordinary search text. No extra listings are returned and no database error is shown.

cases.scenario: Verify that a search keyword of exactly the maximum permitted length is accepted
prerequisites: Database can be accessed
steps: Guest types a keyword of exactly the maximum permitted length into the search box
Guest presses Enter
data: A keyword at the maximum permitted character length
cases.expected: The search runs normally and the results page is displayed.

cases.scenario: Verify that the sort option cannot be tampered with to inject SQL
prerequisites: A search results page is open
steps: Guest edits the sort value in the page address to an SQL fragment
Guest reloads the page
data: The sort value ; DROP TABLE auction
cases.expected: The unrecognised sort value is ignored, the results fall back to the default order, and no database error occurs.

cases.scenario: Verify that price, condition, location and ending time filters can be applied together
prerequisites: Listings exist across several prices, conditions and locations
steps: Guest opens the search results page
Guest sets a price range
Guest selects an item condition
Guest selects a location
Guest selects an ending time window
Guest applies the filters
data: A minimum and maximum price
An item condition
A location
An ending time window
cases.expected: Only listings satisfying all four filters are listed, and every applied filter is shown on the page.

groups.name: Guest: Auction Detail and Seller Profile

cases.scenario: Verify that an unregistered visitor can view the bid history of an auction
prerequisites: An auction with at least one bid exists
No user is logged in
steps: Guest opens an auction detail page
Guest opens the bid history panel
data: An existing auction that has bids
cases.expected: The bid history is displayed and the guest is not redirected to the login page.

cases.scenario: Verify that bidder identities are masked in the public bid history
prerequisites: An auction has bids from several different users
steps: Guest opens the auction detail page
Guest opens the bid history panel
data: An auction with bids from at least three users
cases.expected: Every bidder name and email is shown in masked form, and no full name or full email address appears.

cases.scenario: Verify that requesting an auction that does not exist is handled cleanly
prerequisites: Database can be accessed
steps: Guest edits the auction identifier in the page address to one that does not exist
Guest loads the page
data: An auction identifier that is not in the database
cases.expected: A not found page is shown. No error trace or internal detail is displayed.

cases.scenario: Verify that a public seller profile does not expose the seller's real email address
prerequisites: A seller with completed sales exists
steps: Guest opens a listing by that seller
Guest clicks the seller name to open the public profile
data: A seller account with completed sales
cases.expected: The profile shows a masked email address only, and the full address does not appear anywhere on the page.

cases.scenario: Verify that a visitor can create an account
prerequisites: The chosen username and email are not already registered
Database can be accessed
steps: Guest opens the registration page
Guest fills in every required field
Guest clicks Register
data: An unused username
An unused email address
A password meeting the complexity policy
cases.expected: The account is created and the visitor is taken to the login page.

cases.scenario: Verify that a registrant cannot give themselves the admin role during registration
prerequisites: The chosen username and email are not already registered
steps: Guest opens the registration page
Guest adds a role field set to ADMIN to the submitted form
Guest clicks Register
Admin checks the new account in the user list
data: A registration form carrying role set to ADMIN
cases.expected: The account is created as an ordinary member. The submitted role is ignored and no admin rights are granted.

cases.scenario: Verify that a password which fails the complexity policy is refused at registration
prerequisites: The chosen username and email are not already registered
steps: Guest opens the registration page
Guest enters a weak password
Guest clicks Register
data: A password that does not meet the complexity policy
cases.expected: Registration is refused with a validation message and no account is created.

cases.scenario: Verify that a registered member can log in
prerequisites: An active account exists with a known password
steps: Member opens the login page
Member enters their email and password
Member clicks Login
data: A registered email address
The matching password
cases.expected: The member is logged in and taken to the member area, with their name shown in the navigation bar.

cases.scenario: Verify that a suspended account cannot log in even with the correct password
prerequisites: An account exists whose status is SUSPENDED
steps: Member opens the login page
Member enters the correct email and password of the suspended account
Member clicks Login
data: The email and correct password of a suspended account
cases.expected: Login is refused with a message explaining the account is suspended, and no session is created.

cases.scenario: Verify that repeated failed logins lock the account for a cooldown period
prerequisites: An active account exists with a known password
steps: Member enters the correct email with a wrong password and clicks Login
Member repeats this until the configured attempt limit is reached
Member enters the correct password and clicks Login
data: A registered email address
Wrong passwords repeated up to the attempt limit
The correct password
cases.expected: After the limit is reached the account is locked and the remaining cooldown is shown. The correct password is also refused while the lock is in force.

groups.name: Account: Password Reset, OTP and Two-Factor Authentication

cases.scenario: Verify that a member can reset a forgotten password using a one-time code
prerequisites: An account exists
A valid unexpired one-time code has been issued to that account
Database can be accessed
steps: Member opens the password reset page
Member enters the one-time code
Member enters a new password meeting the complexity policy
Member clicks Reset Password
Member logs in with the new password
data: A valid unexpired one-time code
A new password meeting the complexity policy
cases.expected: The password is changed and the member can log in with it. The stored password is a hash, not readable text, and the one-time code no longer works.

cases.scenario: Verify that an expired one-time code cannot be used to reset a password
prerequisites: A one-time code was issued and has since expired
steps: Member opens the password reset page
Member enters the expired one-time code
Member enters a new password
Member clicks Reset Password
data: An expired one-time code
A new password
cases.expected: The reset is refused with a message saying the code has expired, and the existing password still works.

cases.scenario: Verify that the password reset request does not reveal whether an email address is registered
prerequisites: One registered email address and one unregistered email address are available
steps: Guest opens the forgot password page
Guest submits the registered email address and notes the response
Guest submits the unregistered email address and notes the response
data: A registered email address
An unregistered email address
cases.expected: Both submissions return the same message. Nothing in the response indicates whether the address is registered, and no code is sent for the unregistered address.

cases.scenario: Verify that a one-time code cannot be guessed by repeated attempts
prerequisites: A valid one-time code has been issued to an account
steps: Member enters a wrong one-time code and submits
Member repeats this until the attempt limit is reached
Member enters the correct one-time code and submits
data: Wrong codes repeated up to the attempt limit
The correct one-time code
cases.expected: The code is invalidated once the attempt limit is reached, so even the correct code is refused and a new code must be requested.

cases.scenario: Verify that a member can turn on two-factor authentication
prerequisites: Member is logged in
Member has scanned the setup code into an authenticator app
steps: Member opens the security settings page
Member starts two-factor setup
Member enters the six digit code shown by the authenticator app
Member clicks Confirm
data: The current six digit code from the authenticator app
cases.expected: Two-factor authentication is turned on for the account and the setting is shown as enabled.

cases.scenario: Verify that a wrong two-factor code at login does not grant access
prerequisites: An account has two-factor authentication enabled
The correct password has already been entered
steps: Member enters an incorrect six digit code at the two-factor prompt
Member clicks Verify
data: An incorrect six digit code
cases.expected: Access is refused, the member stays on the two-factor prompt, and no logged in session is created.

groups.name: Platform: Session, Access Control and Security

cases.scenario: Verify that a visitor with no session is denied every role restricted page
prerequisites: No user is logged in
steps: Guest enters the address of the admin dashboard and loads the page
Guest enters the address of the seller dashboard and loads the page
Guest enters the address of the watchlist page and loads the page
data: The addresses of the admin, seller and watchlist pages
cases.expected: Every page is refused and the guest is sent to the login page. No page grants access by default.

cases.scenario: Verify that a buyer cannot reach any admin page
prerequisites: Buyer is logged in with an ordinary member account
steps: Buyer enters the address of the admin dashboard
Buyer loads the page
data: The address of the admin dashboard
cases.expected: Access is refused before the page loads, and no admin content is shown.

cases.scenario: Verify that an admin can reach the admin dashboard
prerequisites: Admin is logged in
steps: Admin opens the admin dashboard
data: An account holding the admin role
cases.expected: The admin dashboard loads and its content is displayed.

cases.scenario: Verify that a session cannot be reused after logging out
prerequisites: Member is logged in and has a protected page open
steps: Member clicks Logout
Member presses the browser back button to return to the protected page
Member refreshes the page
data: A protected page opened before logout
cases.expected: The page is no longer accessible and the member is sent to the login page.

cases.scenario: Verify that every response carries the browser security headers
prerequisites: The site is running
steps: Tester opens any page with the browser developer tools open
Tester inspects the response headers on the network tab
data: Any page request
cases.expected: The response carries the content security policy, content type options and frame options headers.

cases.scenario: Verify that personal data is encrypted at rest and that identical values do not produce identical stored values
prerequisites: Two member accounts exist
Database can be accessed
steps: Member A saves a phone number on the profile page
Member B saves the same phone number on their profile page
Tester reads both stored phone values from the database
data: One phone number saved on two different accounts
cases.expected: Neither stored value is readable text, and the two stored values differ from each other even though the entered number was the same.

cases.scenario: Verify that text entered by a user cannot run as script when it is displayed
prerequisites: Member is logged in
steps: Member enters a script tag into a free text field such as a question or description
Member saves the entry
Member opens the page where that text is displayed
data: The text <script>alert(1)</script>
cases.expected: The text is shown as plain characters on the page and no script runs.

groups.name: Buyer: Bidding on Ascending, Dutch and Buy It Now Auctions

cases.scenario: Verify that a buyer can place a valid bid on an ascending auction
prerequisites: Buyer is logged in
A live ascending auction exists
Buyer does not own the auction
steps: Buyer opens the auction detail page
Buyer enters an amount above the current price
Buyer clicks Place Bid
data: An amount higher than the current price
cases.expected: The bid is accepted, the current price updates to the new amount, and a confirmation message is shown.

cases.scenario: Verify that a seller cannot bid on their own listing
prerequisites: Seller is logged in
The seller owns a live auction
steps: Seller opens their own auction detail page
Seller enters a valid bid amount
Seller clicks Place Bid
data: A valid bid amount on the seller's own auction
cases.expected: The bid is refused with a message explaining a seller cannot bid on their own listing, and the price is unchanged.

cases.scenario: Verify that a bid equal to the current price is refused
prerequisites: Buyer is logged in
A live ascending auction has a known current price
steps: Buyer opens the auction detail page
Buyer enters an amount exactly equal to the current price
Buyer clicks Place Bid
data: An amount equal to the current price
cases.expected: The bid is refused because the price must increase, and the current price is unchanged.

cases.scenario: Verify that a negative bid amount is refused
prerequisites: Buyer is logged in
A live ascending auction exists
steps: Buyer opens the auction detail page
Buyer enters a negative amount
Buyer clicks Place Bid
data: The amount -50
cases.expected: A validation message is shown, the bid is not recorded, and the current price is unchanged.

cases.scenario: Verify that a bid on an auction that has already ended is refused
prerequisites: Buyer is logged in
An auction whose end time has passed exists
steps: Buyer opens the ended auction detail page
Buyer enters a valid amount
Buyer clicks Place Bid
data: A valid bid amount on an ended auction
cases.expected: The bid is refused with a message saying the auction is closed, and no bid is recorded.

cases.scenario: Verify that the displayed price of a Dutch auction falls over time and never goes below the floor price
prerequisites: A Dutch auction exists with a start price, a floor price, a start time and an end time
steps: Buyer opens the Dutch auction detail page at the start time and notes the price
Buyer reopens the page halfway through the auction and notes the price
Buyer reopens the page at the end time and notes the price
data: A Dutch auction with a start price and a lower floor price
cases.expected: The price equals the start price at the start, has fallen to the midpoint value halfway through, and never drops below the floor price.

cases.scenario: Verify that a bid below the required increment is refused and the minimum is shown
prerequisites: Buyer is logged in
A live auction exists with a known current price and increment
steps: Buyer opens the auction detail page
Buyer enters an amount below the required minimum
Buyer clicks Place Bid
data: An amount below the current price plus the increment
cases.expected: The bid is refused and the message states the minimum amount that would be accepted.

cases.scenario: Verify that a buyer cannot place bids faster than the cooldown allows
prerequisites: Buyer is logged in
Buyer has just placed a bid on the auction
steps: Buyer immediately enters a higher amount
Buyer clicks Place Bid before the cooldown has passed
data: A second bid placed inside the cooldown window
cases.expected: The second bid is refused with a message asking the buyer to wait, and only the first bid is recorded.

cases.scenario: Verify that a rival bidder cannot see the leading bid while a blind auction is open
prerequisites: Buyer is logged in
A live blind auction has three sealed bids, the highest being 250 dollars
The buyer does not own the auction
steps: Buyer opens the blind auction detail page
data: A live blind auction with a leading sealed bid of 250 dollars
cases.expected: No current bid amount is displayed. The page marks the auction as sealed and shows only the number of bids received.

cases.scenario: Verify that an unregistered visitor cannot see the leading bid of an open blind auction
prerequisites: A live blind auction with sealed bids exists
No user is logged in
steps: Guest opens the blind auction detail page
data: A live blind auction with a leading sealed bid of 250 dollars
cases.expected: No current bid amount is displayed, and the page does not treat the visitor as the owner.

cases.scenario: Verify that the seller can see the standing bid on their own blind auction
prerequisites: Seller is logged in
The seller owns a live blind auction with a leading sealed bid of 250 dollars
steps: Seller opens their own blind auction detail page
data: A live blind auction owned by the logged in seller
cases.expected: The standing bid of 250 dollars is displayed to the seller, so that the Declare Winner Early option can be used at that price.

cases.scenario: Verify that the winning amount of a blind auction is revealed once it closes
prerequisites: Buyer is logged in
A blind auction has passed its end time
steps: Buyer opens the closed blind auction detail page
data: A closed blind auction whose winning bid was 250 dollars
cases.expected: The winning bid of 250 dollars is displayed and the auction is no longer marked as sealed.

cases.scenario: Verify that a bidder can see their own sealed bid but not anyone else's
prerequisites: Buyer is logged in
The buyer has submitted a sealed bid of 120 dollars
Another bidder holds the leading bid of 250 dollars
steps: Buyer opens the blind auction detail page
data: The buyer's own sealed bid of 120 dollars
cases.expected: The buyer's own bid of 120 dollars is shown, and no leading bid amount is displayed.

cases.scenario: Verify that the bid history is empty while a blind auction is still open
prerequisites: A live blind auction has three sealed bids
steps: Buyer opens the blind auction detail page
Buyer opens the bid history panel
data: A live blind auction with three sealed bids
cases.expected: The bid history lists no entries. The total count of three is shown, but no amount or bidder appears.

cases.scenario: Verify that the live price update on an open blind auction carries no amount
prerequisites: A live blind auction with a leading bid of 250 dollars is open in the browser
Another bidder places a sealed bid
steps: Buyer keeps the blind auction detail page open
A second bidder submits a sealed bid
Buyer watches the page update without reloading
data: A sealed bid submitted by another bidder while the page is open
cases.expected: The bid count on the page increases, and no bid amount is displayed at any point.

cases.scenario: Verify that no listing view reveals the leading bid of a live blind auction
prerequisites: A live blind auction exists with a starting price of 100 dollars and a leading sealed bid of 250 dollars
steps: Guest finds the blind auction in the search results and notes the price on the card
Guest applies a price filter that would only match the sealed amount
Guest checks the trending listings strip
Guest checks the featured listings strip
data: A blind auction with a starting price of 100 dollars and a sealed leading bid of 250 dollars
cases.expected: Every view shows the starting price of 100 dollars. The price filter does not single the listing out, so the sealed amount cannot be worked out from any listing view.

cases.scenario: Verify that a buyer can submit a sealed bid and is told only that it was received
prerequisites: Buyer is logged in
A live blind auction exists
The buyer has not yet bid on it
steps: Buyer opens the blind auction detail page
Buyer enters a sealed bid amount
Buyer clicks Submit Sealed Bid
data: A sealed bid of 250 dollars
cases.expected: A confirmation states that the sealed bid was received. No price, ranking or comparison against other bids is shown.

cases.scenario: Verify that a buyer cannot submit a second sealed bid on the same auction
prerequisites: Buyer is logged in
The buyer has already submitted a sealed bid on this auction
steps: Buyer opens the same blind auction detail page
Buyer enters a higher amount
Buyer clicks Submit Sealed Bid
data: A second sealed bid higher than the buyer's first
cases.expected: The submission is refused with the message that a sealed bid has already been submitted for this auction, and the original bid is unchanged.

cases.scenario: Verify that the entry price of a blind auction is an inclusive minimum to the cent
prerequisites: A live blind auction has a starting price of 100 dollars
Two buyer accounts are available
steps: First buyer submits a sealed bid of exactly 100.00 dollars
Second buyer submits a sealed bid of 99.99 dollars
data: A sealed bid of 100.00 dollars
A sealed bid of 99.99 dollars
cases.expected: The bid of 100.00 dollars is accepted. The bid of 99.99 dollars is refused as too low and is not recorded.

cases.scenario: Verify that Buy It Now and Dutch acceptance cannot be used on a blind auction
prerequisites: Buyer is logged in
A live blind auction exists
steps: Buyer attempts a Buy It Now purchase on the blind auction
Buyer attempts to accept the current Dutch clock price on the blind auction
data: A Buy It Now request on a blind auction
A Dutch acceptance request on a blind auction
cases.expected: Both attempts are refused with a message that the action does not apply to this auction type, and nothing is purchased.

cases.scenario: Verify that submitting a sealed bid sends no outbid or new bid notification
prerequisites: A live blind auction already has sealed bids from other buyers
Those buyers have notifications turned on
steps: A new buyer submits a higher sealed bid
Earlier bidders check their notifications
The seller checks their notifications
data: A new sealed bid that exceeds the existing highest
cases.expected: No outbid notification reaches the earlier bidders and no new bid notification reaches the seller, so no message discloses the standing amount.

cases.scenario: Verify that the highest sealed bid wins when a blind auction closes and the order is raised for that amount
prerequisites: A blind auction has several sealed bids
The highest is 250 dollars from one buyer
The auction has passed its end time
steps: Tester waits for the auction to be finalised
Winning buyer opens their purchases page
Losing bidders check their notifications
data: Sealed bids where the highest is 250 dollars
cases.expected: The buyer who bid 250 dollars is the winner, one order is raised for exactly 250.00 dollars, the winner is notified that they won, and every other bidder is notified that they lost.

cases.scenario: Verify that watchlisting a live blind auction does not reveal its leading bid
prerequisites: Buyer is logged in
A live blind auction has a starting price of 100 dollars and a leading sealed bid of 250 dollars
steps: Buyer adds the blind auction to their watchlist
Buyer opens the watchlist page
Buyer reads the price shown on the watchlist entry
data: A live blind auction on the buyer's watchlist
cases.expected: The watchlist shows the starting price of 100 dollars. The sealed leading bid of 250 dollars does not appear.

cases.scenario: Verify that a public seller profile does not reveal the leading bid of a live blind auction
prerequisites: A seller has a live blind listing with a starting price of 100 dollars and a leading sealed bid of 250 dollars
No user is logged in
steps: Guest opens the seller's public profile page
Guest reads the price shown against the blind listing
data: A seller profile showing a live blind listing
cases.expected: The profile shows the starting price of 100 dollars. The sealed leading bid does not appear to a visitor with no session.

cases.scenario: Verify that the bid history of a live blind auction is empty on every page that displays it
prerequisites: A live blind auction has sealed bids
steps: Guest opens the auction detail page and checks the bid history panel
Guest opens the standalone bid history page for the same auction directly by its address
data: A live blind auction with sealed bids
cases.expected: Neither page lists any bid amount. Entering the bid history address directly does not disclose the sealed bids.

cases.scenario: Verify that an ordinary ascending bid on a blind auction is refused outright
prerequisites: Buyer is logged in
A live blind auction exists
The leading sealed amount is not known to the buyer
steps: Buyer submits an ordinary bid of 250 dollars through the standard bidding page instead of the sealed bid form
Buyer repeats with several different amounts and compares the messages
data: Ordinary bids of several different amounts on a blind auction
cases.expected: Every attempt is refused with the same message that the action does not apply to this auction type. No bid is recorded, and the wording never differs according to the amount, so it cannot be used to work out the sealed bid.

cases.scenario: Verify that the search result count cannot be used to work out a sealed bid
prerequisites: A live blind auction has a starting price of 100 dollars and a leading sealed bid of 250 dollars
steps: Guest searches with a price range that excludes 100 dollars but includes 250 dollars
Guest notes the result count shown
Guest narrows the price range repeatedly and watches the count
data: A series of narrowing minimum and maximum price filters
cases.expected: The result count matches the listings actually shown on the page at every step. The blind auction is never counted against its sealed amount, so narrowing the range does not locate it.

cases.scenario: Verify that a blind auction reveals its winning bid once it has ended
prerequisites: A blind auction with sealed bids has passed its end time
The auction is on a buyer's watchlist
steps: Buyer opens the watchlist page after the auction has ended
Buyer opens the auction detail page
Buyer opens the bid history panel
data: A blind auction that has passed its end time
cases.expected: The winning amount is shown on the watchlist, on the detail page and in the bid history. The hiding applies only while the auction is running.

cases.scenario: Verify that an auto-bid cannot be set on a blind auction
prerequisites: Buyer is logged in
A live blind auction exists
steps: Buyer opens the blind auction detail page
Buyer attempts to set an auto-bid ceiling of 500 dollars
data: An auto-bid ceiling of 500 dollars on a blind auction
cases.expected: The request is refused with a message explaining that a sealed auction takes one hidden bid instead, and no auto-bid is stored.

cases.scenario: Verify that an auto-bid stored on a blind auction before the restriction can still be cancelled
prerequisites: Buyer is logged in
An auto-bid row exists against a blind auction from before the restriction
steps: Buyer cancels the auto-bid on that blind auction
data: An existing auto-bid row on a blind auction
cases.expected: The cancellation succeeds and the stored auto-bid is removed.

cases.scenario: Verify that no auto-bid is reported for a blind auction even if one is still stored
prerequisites: Buyer is logged in
An auto-bid row still exists against a blind auction
steps: Buyer opens the blind auction detail page
Buyer checks the auto-bid area
data: A blind auction with a leftover auto-bid row
cases.expected: The page reports that no auto-bid is set, and the stored value is not displayed.

cases.scenario: Verify that a blind auction page does not display an Auto-Bid Active panel
prerequisites: Buyer is logged in
The buyer has a leftover auto-bid of 900 dollars against a live blind auction
steps: Buyer opens the blind auction detail page
data: A leftover auto-bid of 900 dollars on a live blind auction
cases.expected: No Auto-Bid Active panel is shown and the 900 dollar ceiling is not displayed, so the buyer is not promised a defence that will never run.

cases.scenario: Verify that the blind auction restriction has not stopped auto-bidding on ordinary auctions
prerequisites: Buyer is logged in
A live ascending auction exists
steps: Buyer opens the ascending auction detail page
Buyer sets an auto-bid ceiling of 500 dollars
Buyer clicks Save
data: An auto-bid ceiling of 500 dollars on an ascending auction
cases.expected: The auto-bid is accepted and stored as before, and the Auto-Bid Active panel is shown.

cases.scenario: Verify that a buyer can set an auto-bid ceiling on a live auction
prerequisites: Buyer is logged in
A live ascending auction exists
The buyer does not own the auction
steps: Buyer opens the auction detail page
Buyer enters a maximum amount in the auto-bid field
Buyer clicks Set Auto-Bid
data: A maximum auto-bid amount above the current price
cases.expected: The auto-bid is saved, a confirmation is shown, and the stored ceiling is not readable in plain form in the database.

cases.scenario: Verify that when two buyers hold auto-bids the higher ceiling takes the lead
prerequisites: Two buyers have set auto-bids on the same live auction with different maximum amounts
steps: A new bid is placed that triggers both auto-bids
Tester opens the auction detail page and reads the leading bid
data: Two auto-bid ceilings of different amounts on one auction
cases.expected: The buyer with the higher ceiling leads, at one increment above the lower ceiling rather than at their own maximum.

cases.scenario: Verify that two identical auto-bid ceilings are settled in favour of whoever set theirs first
prerequisites: Two buyers have set auto-bids with exactly the same maximum amount on the same auction
The order in which they were set is known
steps: A new bid is placed that triggers both auto-bids
Tester opens the auction detail page and reads the leading bidder
data: Two identical auto-bid ceilings set at different times
cases.expected: The buyer who set their auto-bid first holds the lead. The result is the same on every repeat, not arbitrary.

cases.scenario: Verify that an auto-bid that can no longer be read is treated as absent rather than causing an error
prerequisites: An auto-bid was stored under an encryption key that has since been rotated
Database can be accessed
steps: Buyer opens the auction detail page carrying that auto-bid
A new bid is placed on the auction
data: An auto-bid stored under a superseded encryption key
cases.expected: The page reports no auto-bid set, the auction continues to work, and no bid is placed at an incorrect amount.

groups.name: Buyer: Watchlist, Questions, Ratings and Reports

cases.scenario: Verify that a buyer can add a listing to their watchlist
prerequisites: Buyer is logged in
The auction is not already on the watchlist
steps: Buyer opens an auction detail page
Buyer clicks Add to Watchlist
Buyer opens the watchlist page
data: An existing live auction
cases.expected: A confirmation is shown and the auction appears on the buyer's watchlist.

cases.scenario: Verify that an unregistered visitor cannot view a watchlist
prerequisites: No user is logged in
steps: Guest enters the address of the watchlist page
Guest loads the page
data: The address of the watchlist page
cases.expected: Access is refused and no watchlist entries are shown.

cases.scenario: Verify that a buyer can ask the seller a question and that the text is cleaned before it is shown
prerequisites: Buyer is logged in
The auction does not belong to the buyer
steps: Buyer opens the auction detail page
Buyer types a question containing HTML markup
Buyer clicks Submit Question
Seller checks their notifications
data: Question text containing an HTML tag
cases.expected: The question is posted with the markup shown as plain characters, and the seller receives a notification.

cases.scenario: Verify that only the owning seller can answer a question on a listing
prerequisites: A seller is logged in who does not own the auction
An unanswered question exists on that auction
steps: Seller opens the auction detail page
Seller attempts to submit a reply to the question
data: A reply to a question on another seller's listing
cases.expected: The reply is refused and no answer is stored against the question.

cases.scenario: Verify that only the winning buyer can rate the seller
prerequisites: Buyer is logged in
The auction has finished
The logged in buyer did not win it
steps: Buyer opens the finished auction page
Buyer attempts to submit a rating of 5 for the seller
data: A rating score of 5 from a buyer who did not win
cases.expected: The rating is refused and no rating is recorded against the seller.

cases.scenario: Verify that the rating scale accepts its highest value
prerequisites: Buyer is logged in
The buyer won the auction
The buyer has not yet rated the seller
steps: Buyer opens the finished auction page
Buyer selects the maximum score of 5
Buyer clicks Submit Rating
data: A rating score of 5
cases.expected: The rating is accepted and appears on the seller's profile.

cases.scenario: Verify that a buyer cannot report the same listing twice
prerequisites: Buyer is logged in
The buyer has already submitted a report on this listing that is still open
steps: Buyer opens the same listing
Buyer submits a second report
data: A second report on a listing already reported by this buyer
cases.expected: The second report is refused with a message saying the listing has already been reported, and only one report exists.

groups.name: Buyer: Orders, Payment, Shipping and Refunds

cases.scenario: Verify that a winning buyer can pay for an order with a saved payment method
prerequisites: Buyer is logged in
The buyer has an unpaid order
The buyer has a saved payment method
steps: Buyer opens the purchases page
Buyer selects the unpaid order
Buyer chooses their saved payment method
Buyer clicks Pay
data: An unpaid order
A saved payment method belonging to the buyer
cases.expected: The order is marked as paid, and both the buyer and the seller receive a notification.

cases.scenario: Verify that a buyer cannot pay using another user's saved payment method
prerequisites: Buyer is logged in with an unpaid order
A payment method belonging to a different user is known
steps: Buyer opens the unpaid order
Buyer submits payment referencing another user's saved payment method
data: A payment method identifier belonging to a different user
cases.expected: The payment is refused and the order remains unpaid.

cases.scenario: Verify that shipping cannot be advanced before the order is paid
prerequisites: Seller is logged in
An order on the seller's listing is still unpaid
steps: Seller opens the sales page
Seller selects the unpaid order
Seller attempts to mark it as despatched
data: An unpaid order
cases.expected: The change is refused and the shipping stage stays as it was.

cases.scenario: Verify that a refund request must carry a reason of the minimum length
prerequisites: Buyer is logged in
The buyer has a paid order
steps: Buyer opens the paid order
Buyer clicks Request Refund
Buyer enters a reason shorter than the minimum length
Buyer clicks Submit
data: A refund reason shorter than the minimum permitted length
cases.expected: A validation message is shown and no refund request is raised.

cases.scenario: Verify that an unpaid order past its payment deadline is cancelled automatically
prerequisites: An unpaid order exists that is older than the configured payment deadline
A separate paid order also exists
steps: Tester waits for the scheduled payment timeout to run
Tester opens the order list and checks both orders
data: One unpaid order past the deadline
One paid order
cases.expected: The overdue unpaid order is cancelled. The paid order is untouched and the related auction records are unchanged.

cases.scenario: Verify that a saved card number cannot be changed through the edit form
prerequisites: Buyer is logged in
The buyer has a saved card
steps: Buyer opens the payment methods page
Buyer opens the saved card for editing
Buyer attempts to submit a different card number along with a new expiry date
data: A different card number
A new expiry date
cases.expected: The card number is unchanged. Only the cardholder name and expiry date are updated.

cases.scenario: Verify that a seller can publish a listing with images and tags
prerequisites: Seller is logged in with selling turned on
Database can be accessed
steps: Seller opens the create listing page
Seller fills in the listing details
Seller uploads one or more images
Seller adds tags
Seller clicks Publish
data: A complete set of listing details
One or more permitted image files
One or more tags
cases.expected: The listing is published and appears in search results with its images and tags attached.

cases.scenario: Verify that a member without selling turned on cannot create a listing
prerequisites: A member is logged in who has not turned selling on
steps: Member enters the address of the create listing page
Member fills in the form and clicks Publish
data: A complete listing form submitted by a buyer only account
cases.expected: The request is refused and no listing is created.

cases.scenario: Verify that only permitted image types can be uploaded to a listing
prerequisites: Seller is logged in with selling turned on
steps: Seller opens the create listing page
Seller selects a file with a disallowed extension
Seller clicks Publish
data: A file with a disallowed extension
cases.expected: The upload is refused with a file type message, and no file is saved on the server.

cases.scenario: Verify that an image larger than the size limit is refused
prerequisites: Seller is logged in with selling turned on
steps: Seller opens the create listing page
Seller selects an image larger than the permitted size
Seller clicks Publish
data: An image file exceeding the size limit
cases.expected: The upload is refused with a size message and the listing is not published.

cases.scenario: Verify that a listing that already has bids cannot be edited
prerequisites: Seller is logged in
The seller owns a live auction that has at least one bid
steps: Seller opens their listing
Seller clicks Edit
Seller changes a field and clicks Save
data: An edit to a listing that already has bids
cases.expected: The edit is refused with a message explaining that bidders bid on the original terms, and the listing is unchanged.

cases.scenario: Verify that a bid arriving while the edit form is open still blocks the edit
prerequisites: Seller is logged in
The seller owns a live auction with no bids yet
steps: Seller opens the edit form while the listing has no bids
A buyer places a bid on that listing in another browser
Seller changes a field and clicks Save
data: A bid placed after the edit form was opened but before it was saved
cases.expected: The edit is refused because the check is repeated at save time, and the listing is unchanged.

cases.scenario: Verify that removing the last unit of stock ends the listing and tells the bidders
prerequisites: Seller is logged in
The seller owns a listing with a quantity of 1
The listing has existing bidders
steps: Seller opens the listing
Seller removes the remaining unit and enters a reason
Seller confirms
Bidders check their notifications
data: A listing with a quantity of 1
A removal reason
cases.expected: The listing is ended, the reason is recorded against it, and every bidder receives a notification.

cases.scenario: Verify that an admin can suspend an active member account
prerequisites: Admin is logged in
Database can be accessed
At least one active member account exists
steps: Admin opens the user management page
Admin clicks Suspend next to an active member account
data: An existing active member account
cases.expected: The status of the account becomes SUSPENDED.

cases.scenario: Verify that an admin cannot moderate their own account
prerequisites: Admin is logged in
steps: Admin opens the user management page
Admin attempts to suspend their own account
data: The logged in admin's own account
cases.expected: The action is refused and the admin's own account status is unchanged.

cases.scenario: Verify that one admin cannot change another admin's account status
prerequisites: Admin is logged in
A second admin account exists
steps: Admin opens the user management page
Admin attempts to change the status of the other admin account
data: A second admin account
cases.expected: The action is refused, because admin accounts cannot be moderated from this page.

cases.scenario: Verify that a buyer cannot open the report moderation queue
prerequisites: Buyer is logged in with an ordinary member account
steps: Buyer enters the address of the admin reports page
Buyer loads the page
data: The address of the admin reports page
cases.expected: Access is refused and no report data is shown.

cases.scenario: Verify that a category still used by live auctions cannot be deleted
prerequisites: Admin is logged in
A category is referenced by at least one live auction
steps: Admin opens the category management page
Admin clicks Delete next to that category
data: A category referenced by live auctions
cases.expected: The deletion is refused with a message explaining the category is still in use, and the category remains.

cases.scenario: Verify that a restore file containing destructive statements is rejected
prerequisites: Admin is logged in
A backup file containing DROP or DELETE statements is prepared
steps: Admin opens the database backup and restore page
Admin uploads the prepared file
Admin clicks Restore
data: A backup file containing a DROP statement
cases.expected: The file is rejected before anything runs, and the database is unchanged.

cases.scenario: Verify that a restore file is accepted when a semicolon appears inside a genuine data value
prerequisites: Admin is logged in
A valid backup file is prepared where one inserted value contains a semicolon
steps: Admin opens the database backup and restore page
Admin uploads the prepared file
Admin clicks Restore
data: A backup file whose inserted value contains a semicolon
cases.expected: The restore completes and the value is stored with its semicolon intact, so a legitimate value is not mistaken for a second statement.

cases.scenario: Verify that a signed in buyer receives personalised recommendations
prerequisites: Buyer is logged in
The buyer has browsing or bidding history
steps: Buyer opens the home page
Buyer reads the recommendations strip
data: A buyer account with interaction history
cases.expected: The strip shows recommendations related to the buyer's history and is labelled as personalised.

cases.scenario: Verify that an unregistered visitor still receives useful recommendations
prerequisites: No user is logged in
steps: Guest opens the home page
Guest reads the recommendations strip
data: A home page visit with no session
cases.expected: The strip shows trending listings and is not labelled as personalised.

cases.scenario: Verify that a newly registered user is not shown an empty recommendations strip
prerequisites: A newly registered account exists with no browsing or bidding history
steps: New member logs in
New member opens the home page
New member reads the recommendations strip
data: An account with no interaction history
cases.expected: The strip is filled with trending listings rather than left empty.

cases.scenario: Verify that a single category cannot fill the whole recommendations strip
prerequisites: Buyer is logged in
The buyer's history is concentrated in one category
steps: Buyer opens the home page
Buyer counts the recommendations belonging to each category
data: A buyer history concentrated in one category
cases.expected: No category exceeds the configured limit, and the strip still holds a full set of recommendations.

cases.scenario: Verify that recent activity influences recommendations more than older activity
prerequisites: Buyer is logged in
The buyer has interactions of clearly different ages
steps: Buyer opens the home page
Buyer expands the why this panel on the recommendations and reads the scores
data: Interactions from today and from several weeks ago
cases.expected: Recent interactions carry more weight than older ones, and an interaction dated in the future does not increase a score.

cases.scenario: Verify that the recommendation explanation never identifies a single other user
prerequisites: Buyer is logged in
A recommended item has been interacted with by exactly one other user
steps: Buyer opens the home page
Buyer expands the why this panel on that recommendation
data: A recommended item with exactly one other interacting user
cases.expected: The explanation is worded generally and contains no name, masked or otherwise, that would identify that one user.

cases.scenario: Verify that the leading bidder is told when a higher bid displaces them
prerequisites: An ascending auction has a leading bidder
A second buyer is logged in
steps: Second buyer places a higher bid
Displaced bidder checks their notifications
A third buyer who never bid checks their notifications
data: A bid higher than the current leading bid
cases.expected: The displaced bidder receives exactly one outbid notification. No other user receives it.

cases.scenario: Verify that every losing bidder is told the auction ended and the winner is not
prerequisites: An auction with several bidders has passed its end time
steps: Tester waits for the auction to be finalised
Each losing bidder checks their notifications
The winning bidder checks their notifications
data: An ended auction with one winner and several losing bidders
cases.expected: Each losing bidder receives one notification that they did not win. The winner receives the won notification instead and no losing notification.

cases.scenario: Verify that a losing bidder notification does not reveal who won
prerequisites: An auction with several bidders has been finalised
steps: Losing bidder opens their notifications
Losing bidder reads the full text of the losing notification
data: A losing bidder notification
cases.expected: The message states that the auction ended without naming or otherwise identifying the winning bidder.

cases.scenario: Verify that rapid bidding does not flood the seller with notifications
prerequisites: Seller is logged in
The seller owns a live auction
steps: Several buyers place bids in quick succession on that auction
Seller opens their notifications
data: Several bids placed within a short window
cases.expected: The seller receives a single combined notification carrying the current price rather than one message per bid.

cases.scenario: Verify that a member can switch off every optional notification
prerequisites: Member is logged in
steps: Member opens the notification preferences page
Member turns off every optional notification
Member clicks Save
An event that would normally raise an optional notification occurs
data: All optional notification toggles set to off
cases.expected: The preferences are saved, and no further optional notification is delivered to that member.

cases.scenario: Verify that a member can start linking their Telegram account
prerequisites: Member is logged in
The Telegram bot is configured
steps: Member opens the notification settings page
Member clicks Link Telegram
data: A member account with no Telegram link
cases.expected: The page shows both a link that opens the bot directly and a one-time code that can be sent to the bot by hand.

cases.scenario: Verify that the Telegram webhook only accepts calls carrying the correct secret token
prerequisites: The Telegram bot is configured with a secret token
steps: Tester sends a webhook call carrying a wrong secret token
Tester repeats with a token that is a leading portion of the correct one
data: A wrong secret token
A token matching only the first characters of the correct one
cases.expected: Both calls are rejected and nothing is changed by either of them.

cases.scenario: Verify that link codes cannot be guessed by repeated attempts through the bot
prerequisites: The Telegram bot is configured
A chat is available for testing
steps: Tester sends a wrong link code to the bot
Tester repeats until the attempt limit is reached
Tester sends one more code
data: Wrong link codes repeated up to the attempt limit
cases.expected: The chat is blocked from further attempts once the limit is reached.

cases.scenario: Verify that a Telegram link code can only be used once
prerequisites: A valid unused link code has been issued
steps: Tester sends the link code to the bot from one chat
Tester sends the same link code again from a second chat
data: One valid link code used twice
cases.expected: The first use links the account. The second use is refused and does not link the second chat.

cases.scenario: Verify that blocking the bot stops further messages without causing repeated retries
prerequisites: A member has linked their Telegram account
A notification is queued for that member
steps: Member blocks the bot in Telegram
Tester waits for the queued notification to be sent
Tester checks the member's Telegram link status
data: A queued notification for a chat that has blocked the bot
cases.expected: The link is marked inactive, no message is delivered, and the system does not keep retrying.

cases.scenario: Verify that a phone number and address are stored encrypted when a profile is updated
prerequisites: Member is logged in
Database can be accessed
steps: Member opens the profile page
Member enters a new phone number and address
Member clicks Save
Tester reads the stored values from the database
data: A new phone number
A new address
cases.expected: The profile page shows the new values, and the stored values are not readable as plain text in the database.

cases.scenario: Verify that a member cannot open another user's account page by changing the address
prerequisites: Member is logged in
The identifier of another user's account is known
steps: Member opens their own account page
Member adds another user's identifier to the page address
Member reloads the page
data: Another user's account identifier
cases.expected: The member's own account details are shown. The identifier in the address is ignored and no other user's data is displayed.

cases.scenario: Verify that closing a seller account does not strand a buyer who has already paid
prerequisites: A seller has a sale that is paid but not yet despatched
The seller requests account closure
steps: Seller opens the account settings page
Seller requests account closure and confirms
Admin opens the refund queue
Admin checks their notifications
data: A paid order that has not been despatched
cases.expected: A refund decision is raised for that order and the admins are alerted, so the buyer's payment is not lost.

cases.scenario: Verify that account closure either completes fully or leaves the account untouched
prerequisites: A member account is eligible for closure
A step of the closure process is made to fail
Database can be accessed
steps: Member requests account closure
The closure process fails part way through
Tester inspects the account record
data: An account closure that fails at the cleanup step
cases.expected: The whole closure is rolled back. The account is left as it was, with no partly anonymised details.

cases.ref: ProtectedRoute.test.jsx, sends a signed-out visitor to the login page
cases.scenario: Verify that a guarded page cannot be opened without logging in
prerequisites: No user is logged in
steps: Guest enters the address of a guarded page such as the watchlist
Guest loads the page
data: The address of a guarded page
cases.expected: The guest is redirected to the login page and the guarded content is not shown.

cases.ref: ProtectedRoute.test.jsx, offers the selling gate to a member who has not switched selling on
cases.scenario: Verify that a member without selling turned on is offered the selling opt-in rather than an error
prerequisites: Member is logged in
Selling is not turned on for that account
steps: Member opens a seller page such as the seller dashboard
data: A member account with selling not turned on
cases.expected: The selling opt-in page is shown, explaining how to turn selling on. No error page is displayed.

cases.ref: AuctionCard.test.jsx, only shows the why this panel for a recommended card
cases.scenario: Verify that the why this panel appears only on recommended listings
prerequisites: Buyer is logged in
The home page shows both recommended and ordinary listings
steps: Buyer opens the home page
Buyer checks a card in the recommendations strip
Buyer checks a card in an ordinary listing strip
data: One recommended listing card
One ordinary listing card
cases.expected: The why this panel is offered on the recommended card only, and does not appear on the ordinary card.

cases.ref: AuctionCard.test.jsx, shows the re-ranker score and the component behind it once expanded
cases.scenario: Verify that a buyer can see why an item was recommended
prerequisites: Buyer is logged in
The home page shows recommendations
steps: Buyer opens the home page
Buyer clicks the why this link on a recommended card
data: A recommended listing card
cases.expected: The panel opens and shows the recommendation score together with the main reason behind it.

cases.ref: CountdownTimer.test.jsx, colours by urgency: normal, then amber inside a day, then red in the last hour
cases.scenario: Verify that the countdown changes colour as an auction approaches its end time
prerequisites: Three auctions exist, ending in more than a day, in less than a day, and in less than an hour
steps: Buyer opens the search results page showing all three auctions
Buyer compares the countdown colour on each
data: An auction ending in more than a day
An auction ending in less than a day
An auction ending in less than an hour
cases.expected: The countdown is shown in the neutral colour, amber and red respectively.

cases.ref: Modal.test.jsx, moves focus to the first focusable element on open
cases.scenario: Verify that a dialog can be operated by keyboard
prerequisites: Member is logged in
A page with a dialog such as a confirmation prompt is open
steps: Member opens the dialog using the keyboard
Member presses Tab to move through the dialog
Member closes the dialog
data: A dialog opened from a button on the page
cases.expected: Focus moves into the dialog when it opens, stays within it while tabbing, and returns to the button that opened it when it closes.

cases.ref: AccountSettings.test.jsx, does not offer the card number for editing, and says why
cases.scenario: Verify that the card editing screen does not offer the card number for editing
prerequisites: Buyer is logged in
The buyer has a saved card
steps: Buyer opens the payment methods page
Buyer opens the saved card for editing
data: A saved card
cases.expected: No card number field is offered, and the page explains that the card number cannot be changed.

cases.ref: usePolling.test.jsx, stops polling and aborts the in-flight request on unmount
cases.scenario: Verify that live price updates stop when the buyer leaves the auction page
prerequisites: Buyer is logged in
An auction detail page is open with the browser developer tools on the network tab
steps: Buyer watches the repeating price requests on the network tab
Buyer navigates away to another page
Buyer watches the network tab again
data: An open auction detail page polling for price updates
cases.expected: The repeating requests stop as soon as the page is left, and any request still in progress is cancelled.
